title: Weighted Boolean sum tail bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ assign a real weight to each point of the Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $t\\ge 0$. Choose a function $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ uniformly at random, and write $f(a)$ for its sign value. The probability that $\\left|\\sum_{a\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n} w(a)f(a)\\right|\\ge t$ is at most $2\\exp\\left(-\\frac{t^2}{2\\sum_a w(a)^2}\\right)$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
